overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator; collapsed into one overload. Also fixed direction: attribValue defaults to 'in' in the mechanical draft, but the doc's arrow column marks it '<-' (out) since the command writes the attribute's current value into it.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'pictureObject' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'pictureObject' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: pictureObject
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: element_ID
params.description: ID of element whose attribute value you want to get

params.name: attribName
params.description: Attribute whose value you want to get

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reads the current value of a named attribute of an SVG XML element (or, for the * form, of the rendered image attached to a form object) into attribValue.

constraints: When object is passed via '*', the value returned reflects the rendered image attached to that form object (which may have been modified at runtime by SVG SET ATTRIBUTE); when passed as a Variable/Field, the value returned reflects the initial rendered image corresponding to that data source.
